kind_labels.X: Attachment, map or correspondence filed with another record (not a separate document)
kind_labels.L: Land order: withdrawal, reservation, restoration, modification, land sale or land-office order
kind_labels.O: Other operative order, rule, regulation or directive
kind_labels.N: NRA code of fair competition, or its amendment, approval or exemption
kind_labels.R: Request to the Reconstruction Finance Corporation
kind_labels.E: Exception to the arms-export prohibition for one shipment
kind_labels.V: Commission for one private armed vessel
kind_labels.S: Public land sale proclamation, postponement or land-office notice
kind_labels.Q: Proclamation (extra session, thanksgiving and the like)
kind_labels.I: Interpretation of a land order (almost all not signed by the President)
kind_labels.A: Appointment, designation, promotion or assignment of a person
kind_labels.P: Pardon, commutation, remission, respite or amnesty
kind_labels.F: Approval of a fund allotment, transfer or payment
kind_labels.M: Pass, permit, discharge, dismissal, sentence or other action on one person
